name: cowork-flow
description: CLI for installing and maintaining cowork-flow collaboration templates.

scripts.test:fast: node --test test/asset-plan.test.js test/cli.test.js test/cli-registry.test.js test/claude-code-plugin.test.js test/codex-plugin.test.js test/contract-fingerprint.test.js test/docs.test.js test/host-assets.test.js test/host-command.test.js test/kimi-hook.test.js test/opencode-plugin.test.js test/package.test.js test/plugin-metadata.test.js test/plugin-payload.test.js test/qoder-plugin.test.js test/stage-contract.test.js test/template-runner.test.js test/update.test.js test/zcode-plugin.test.js
scripts.test:integration: node --test --test-name-pattern="^(init copies the template into a new target directory|sync updates safe template files and preserves protected files)$" test/init.test.js test/sync.test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:node:full && npm run test:template:full && npm run pack:check
scripts.test:windows:core: npm run test:fast && npm run test:integration && node --test test/dsh-home-patch.test.js test/dsh-hook.test.js test/dsh-preset.test.js test/mcp-client-matrix.test.js test/mcp-state-command.test.js && npm run pack:check && npm run test:template
